svg.text: I03 / 束环与发光状态环
FIVE ORTHOGRAPHIC VIEWS / metres / design proxy v1 / same scale / solid colours are material IDs
Origin: shared local coordinates; front = -Z, up = +Y. Top view: -Z toward page top.
PORTS: 匹配罐体外径；轴向环位
DETAIL: 实体箍环承载状态光；不靠 bloom 代替几何
COLLISION: 并入静态罐；非交互
VARIANTS: 普通／过载只变 uniform
Planning drawing only. Not a production mesh, construction engineering drawing or measured reconstruction of the AI image.
